page.layout: Full-width running text on one printed page, with a page number at the head. Left margin holds marginal notes ("De auctis in iuramento, cap.3." and "De auctis in precatione, cap.4."). Within the text block are brace diagrams (Aucta/Nova, Aucta sunt, Iuramentum augetur, Speciália). Right edge shows the adjoining page (show-through/neighbour edge, not transcribed).

main_text.p: pia, qualis à Diabolo docetur. Exo.7.11.
Incantatio est, quæ ex pacto cum Diabolo expresso vel implicito per ceremonias quasdam, vt muffitationem &c. exercetur. Psal. 58. 6. Eccle.10, 11. Deut.18 11.
De auctis in iuramento, cap.3.Diui cultus media hic tractanda sunt {Aucta. / Noua.}
main_text.l: Aucta sunt: Communia angelis & hominibus, Hominibus propria.
main_text.p: Ceremonia est ritus in iuramentis, pro iurantium differentia conuenienter adhibitus.
Sic inferiores superiorum femore manum ponebant. Gen.24.2. & 34.7.
Sic cumuli & statuæ inter iurantes æquales iniciebant, & ad testimonium coram hominibus. Gen.32.51.
Sic inter se reconciliantes dona mutua. Gene. 21.27.
Lex est, vt iurantes iusiurandum, etiamsi fit in damnum illorum præstant. Psal.15.4.
In precatione augmenta communia sunt, vt fiant tantum in Christi nomine.
De auctis in precatione, cap.4.Specialia sunt vel in Petitione. Gratiarum actione.
In petitione augmenta sunt vel Ijs quæ petuntur. de Petendi forma.

page.notes: Marginal notes in left margin are transcribed as printed in the note elements. Brace diagrams are reduced to outline lines; the original braces and their exact alignment are approximate. The scan is cut at the right edge; the right-hand page's text is not transcribed. Doubtful: "Speciália" read as "Specialia"; "Ijs" as printed.
